rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for consciously noticing or becoming aware of something.

example.english: I notice that they don’t seem very energetic today.
example.traditional: 我留意到佢今日冇乜精神。
example.jyutping: ngo5 lau4 ji3 dou2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 mou5 mat1 zing1 san4

rows.note: Use this when noticing means seeing or spotting something visually.

example.english: I notice a cat by the doorway.
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 mun4 hau2 gin3 dou2 jat1 zek3 maau1

rows.note: Use this when the notice involves discovering or realizing a fact, often unexpectedly.

example.english: I only notice when I get home that my keys are missing.
example.traditional: 我返到屋企先發現唔見咗鎖匙。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan1 dou3 uk1 kei2 sin1 faat3 jin6 m4 gin3 zo2 so2 si4

rows.note: Use this for deliberately observing something, especially over a period of time.

example.english: After observing the bird all morning, I notice that it is unusually noisy.
example.traditional: 我觀察隻雀仔成個朝早，發現佢特別嘈。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gun1 caat3 zek3 zoek3 zai2 seng4 go3 ziu1 zou2 faat3 jin6 keoi5 dak6 bit6 cou4

rows.note: Use 通知 for a neutral advance, formal, or employment-related notification rather than for a posted sign or a warning itself.

example.english: The company has already given me notice that my contract will end next month.
example.traditional: 公司已經通知我，下個月會完約。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ji5 ging1 tung1 zi1 ngo5 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 jyun4 joek3

rows.note: Use 警告 for the warning slice of sense 2 when the notice alerts people to danger or a possible penalty.

example.english: This warning notice says that illegally parked cars may be fined.
example.traditional: 呢張警告寫明，亂泊車會畀人罰款。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 ging2 gou3 se2 ming4 lyun6 paak3 ce1 wui5 bei2 jan4 fat6 fun2

rows.note: Use 注意 as the all-purpose noun for attention or taking notice of something.

example.english: If I don't pay attention, I fail to notice a detail.
example.traditional: 我一唔注意，就睇漏咗個細節。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 m4 zyu3 ji3 zau6 tai2 lau6 zo2 go3 sai3 zit3

rows.note: Use 通告 for a written or printed announcement, especially an official notice displayed for people to read.

example.english: A notice has been posted in the lobby saying the power will be cut tomorrow.
example.traditional: 大堂貼咗張通告，話聽日停電。
example.jyutping: daai6 tong4 tip3 zo2 zoeng1 tung1 gou3 waa6 ting1 jat6 ting4 din6
